summary: Telefonica Brasil S.A. filed a 6-K furnishing minutes of its 533rd board meeting held September 14, 2026, at which directors unanimously approved a declaration of interest on capital of R$500,000,000.00 gross, R$412,500,000.00 net of 17.5% withholding tax, equal to R$0.15646482856 per share gross. The record date is September 25, 2026, with shares trading ex-IoC thereafter and payment by April 30, 2027, allocated to the 2026 mandatory minimum dividend, subject to ratification at the 2027 ordinary general meeting. This is a routine capital distribution, not a special situation.
